mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 9 degrees now, scattered clouds. Next 24 hours: high 15, low 7.

Nvidia lost about $1.8 trillion in market value after its CEO Jensen Huang stepped down.

Explosions were heard in Kyiv as authorities said the city was hit by a Russian ballistic missile attack.

Sixteen-year-old Argentine player Abel Núñez of FC Ezeiza died on Sunday after being struck in the head by a ball during a match.

Seven of the eight quarter-finalists for the 2026/27 UEFA Nations League have been decided, with Germany and the Netherlands securing the final spots.

Kosovo's ambassador to Croatia, Martin Berishaj, denied receiving any payment from the Serbian firm GEN-i Beograd after the allegation surfaced.
